scheme_name: Subsidy Scheme On Establishment Of 25 R.I.R. Birds’ Unit For Scheduled Caste
other_conditions: Adult member of the Scheduled Caste category
Only one member per family can benefit
Beneficiary must provide income proof and caste certificate
Females and Below Poverty Line beneficiaries are given priority
Beneficiary must have completed poultry‑keeping training
Must keep the birds safe during night hours
Unit must be maintained for two years
Beneficiary must show income and expenditure statement when visited by a government officer
benefits_summary: Provides a 25 R.I.R birds unit with a subsidy covering up to 75% (maximum ₹4500) of the cost in the form of birds and poultry feed.
